JVNDB-2026-000107
freo2 vulnerable to unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type
Overview
freo2 provided by refirio is a content management system written in PHP. freo2 contains the following vulnerability.
Unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type (CWE-434) - CVE-2026-67243
Kazuki Ozawa of Mitsui Bussan Secure Directions, Inc. reported this vulnerability to IPA.
JPCERT/CC coordinated with the developer under Information Security Early Warning Partnership.
